# samsungcloudplatformv2_ske_cluster_deletion_protection (Data Source)

Gets the deletion protection status of an SKE cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID
  - example: YOUR RESOURCE'S CLUSTER_ID

### Read-Only

- `deletion_protection_enabled` (Boolean) Deletion protection flag. True when cluster deletion is prevented.
  - example: true
